types.name: Embedded figure
types.description: You select the option figure in which a given figure (X) is hidden as a part, or the option hidden in a given complex figure, usually with rotation not allowed.

types.name: Completing a pattern
types.description: A figure has a missing part marked with a question mark, and you choose the piece that completes the pattern.

types.name: Figure series
types.description: A row of figures changes step by step and you choose the figure that comes next or fills the question mark in the series.

types.name: Figure analogy
types.description: Figure A is related to figure B, and you apply the same change to figure C to find D ("A : B :: C : ?").

types.name: Odd figure out
types.description: Four or five figures are given, and you pick the one that does not follow the rule shared by the others.

types.name: Rotating a figure
types.description: You choose how a figure looks after being rotated by a stated angle (for example 90° clockwise, or 135° clockwise then 45° anticlockwise).
